conbody.p: Integrated memory system for the driver’s seat is provided to store and recall the following memory settings with a simple button operation.

note.p: Never attempt to operate the integrated memory system while the vehicle is moving.
This could result in loss of control, and an accident causing death, serious injury, or property damage.

li.p: If the battery is disconnected, the memory settings will be erased.
If integrated memory system does not operate normally, have the system inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
